en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town taken from a field. The image features a collection of historic buildings with sloped roofs, a prominent church with a tall spire at the center, another rounded towered building, and several houses surrounded by fields and trees. The upper left corner has red printed text reading 'Mügeln, Bez. Leipzig.'
